messages.content: Let me look that up for you...

function.name: search_knowledge_base
function.description: Search the TalentBridge knowledge base for accurate information about job roles, company policies, benefits, qualification criteria, screening process, FAQs, and objection handling. Use this function for ANY factual question about TalentBridge, its positions, or policies. NEVER answer factual questions without consulting this function first.

query.description: The search query based on what the candidate is asking about. Be specific and include key terms.

category.description: Optional category to narrow the search. Use 'jobs' for role details, 'benefits' for compensation/perks, 'process' for screening/interview steps, 'qualification' for eligibility rules, 'objections' for handling candidate concerns, 'company' for about/culture info, 'faq' for common questions.

function.name: save_lead
function.description: Save the candidate's screening information and qualification score to the CRM. Call this at the end of the screening conversation after collecting all required information.

applied_position.description: The position the candidate applied for

reason_for_change.description: Why the candidate is looking for a change

qualification_score.description: Qualification score based on screening criteria: hot (meets all requirements, available soon), warm (meets most, minor gaps), cold (significant mismatches)

notes.description: Additional notes from the screening call

messages.content: I'm connecting you with a human recruiter now. Please hold for just a moment.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Transfer the call to a human recruiter. Use when: the candidate explicitly asks for a human, complex negotiation is needed, disability accommodations are requested, legal/compliance questions arise, or you've failed to answer 3+ questions from the knowledge base.

reason.description: Why the call is being transferred

priority.description: Priority level: high for upset candidates or compliance issues, medium for standard transfers, low for informational follow-ups
